basic_details.job_title: MIMUL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 13 Management Trainee, Executive and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Midnapore Co-op Milk Producers' Union Ltd. (MIMUL) has notified 13 vacancies under advertisement number MU: CE:26-27/382 for Management Trainee (MT)- Field Extension Activity, Management Trainee (MT) in Plant Operation, Account Assistant/Jr. Account Assistant, and Executive (Sales) posts on a contract basis. The assignment is initially for one year, with any extension subject to satisfactory performance. The notified pay is Rs. 15,000.00 per month for Management Trainee posts, while the pay for Account Assistant/Jr. Account Assistant and Executive (Sales) is negotiable. Eligible candidates

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The recruitment drive offers a total of 13 vacancies across different positions. The post-wise distribution of vacancies is detailed below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Management Trainee (Field Extension Activity): Graduate in any discipline. Candidates with experience in milk procurement, working as secretary/milk tester at Dairy Co-operative Society, or field extension activity for Dairy Co-operative society formation are given priority. Management Trainee (Plant Operation): Graduate in Science in any subject. Candidates with experience in milk chilling plant operation, dairy plant operation, and milk testing are given priority. Account Assistant/Jr. Account Assistant: B.Com (Graduate) with knowledge in Tally entry and operation. At least two years of Tally entry and operation experience is mandatory. Executive (Sales): Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University. MBA/BBA or higher qualification receives additional weightage. Must have a minimum of 02 years of experience in the field of marketing of packet milk and milk products of reputed brands. The maximum age limit is 40 years as on 01.01.2026 for all posts. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government norms.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Management Trainee positions carry a consolidated stipend of Rs. 15,000.00 per month along with other admissible benefits as per Milk Union's norms. Remuneration for Account Assistant and Executive (Sales) is negotiable based on qualification and experience, accompanied by admissible benefits as per Milk Union's norms for contractual engagements. All engagements are initially for a period of one year, and any extension is subject to satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: MIMUL Management Trainee Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will perform various operational duties depending on their assigned posts: Management Trainee (Field Extension Activity): Village survey, data collection and entry; assessing milk production, surplus availability, and feasibility of Dairy Co-operative formation; conducting awareness programs and training; milk testing and AMCU operation; guiding Dairy Co-operative societies. Management Trainee (Plant Operation): Receiving milk from societies, testing, recording, chilling, and dispatching; operating and maintaining Bulk Milk Cooling units and maintaining plant hygiene; maintaining relations with societies and farmers; managing records and reports. Account Assistant/Jr. Account Assistant: General entry in Tally and billing software; bill generation and related activities; ledger posting, general accounts work, and handling accounting & taxation tasks; bill verification and release of payments. Executive (Sales): Marketing MIMUL milk and milk products, increasing sales volume, and handling distributors and retailers; planning and achieving sales targets; developing marketing intelligence; ensuring collection of sales proceeds; managing assets and logistics for distribution.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MIMUL Management Trainee
content_sections.text: Check eligibility criteria for the desired post from the official notification. Prepare the complete application format along with self-attested photocopies of educational certificates (Madhyamik Pariksha admit card and mark sheets, Higher Secondary, and Graduation certificates) and relevant experience documents. Place the application and required enclosures inside an envelope. Send the application via Post or Courier to the designated address: The Midnapore Co-op. Milk Producers' Union Ltd., Ashok Nagar, Midnapore, Paschim Medinipur. PIN - 721101 . Ensure the application reaches the office positively within or on 06th November 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of short-listing of candidates followed by an interview. Shortlisting: Shortlists of eligible candidates are prepared based on the aggregate of marks obtained (ten percent) in Madhyamik Pariksha (MP), Higher Secondary Examination (HS), and Graduation. Vocational or distant courses are not considered for shortlisting. Total Marks Distribution: Madhyamik Pariksha (MP) - 10 Marks, Higher Secondary (HS) - 10 Marks, Graduation - 10 Marks, and Interview - 10 Marks (covering experience, personal appearance, speaking ability, and knowledge), totaling 40 Marks. Interview: Only short-listed eligible candidates will be called for an interview. Venues, dates, and times will be communicated directly to eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 13 vacancies are notified across various contractual posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications through post or courier is 06 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for Management Trainee (Field Extension Activity)?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates in any discipline, with preference given to those experienced in milk procurement or dairy co-operative society operations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years as on 01.01.2026, with relaxations applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee required for MIMUL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. Through what mode should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their completed applications offline through Post or Courier.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection procedure for these posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting derived from academic marks in MP, HS, and Graduation, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly stipend/salary provided for Management Trainee posts?
faq.answer: Management Trainees receive a stipend of Rs. 15,000.00 per month along with admissible benefits.

faq.question: Q9. Are TA/DA provided for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, TA/DA will not be allowed for attending the interview.
